goal: Emit explicit black Heading 1/2/3 styles, verify the complete LibreOffice PDF, and install the tested macOS application.
test_paths: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_template.py tests/test_docx_renderer.py tests/test_pdf_preview.py tests/test_acceptance.py
non_goals: Do not change template schema or DOCX Renderer behavior.
Do not perform agent-driven UI sensory or claim WPS/Word equality.
unsafe_assumptions: DOCX color must be verified in styles.xml, including absence of theme color modifiers.
Real PDF font embedding and page count must be inspected from the current artifact.
A successful package command does not prove the installed app is the new build.
stop_condition: Stop if heading color requires schema or Renderer changes, validation fails, the real PDF still embeds ArialUnicodeMS for body text, or installation cannot be verified.
